root_cause.text: The imx-tve driver failed to release a device reference obtained by `of_find_i2c_adapter_by_node()` during probe, causing a reference leak on probe failure and driver unbind.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `devm_add_action_or_reset` call to invoke `put_device` on the DDC device (`&tve->ddc->dev`) after acquiring the adapter reference. The commit message states: "Make sure to drop the reference taken to the DDC device during probe on probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on driver unbind."
